description: Defines a templated FrameType class with nested AllocatorType, Reader, and Writer classes for handling binary data buffers, including serialization/deserialization, buffer management, and variable-length number encoding. Contains utility functions and template specializations for endianess and size handling.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: A templated class for managing binary data frames with buffer allocation, serialization, and deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: FrameType::AllocatorType
classes.description: Handles dynamic buffer allocation with support for reallocations and move semantics.

classes.name: FrameType::Reader
classes.description: Provides methods to read and interpret data from a FrameType buffer, including variable-length encoding and type-specific getters.

classes.name: FrameType::Writer
classes.description: Provides methods to write data into a FrameType buffer, including variable-length encoding and type-specific setters.

methods.name: buffer_length_cast
methods.description: Converts input length to a new type with safety checks, used for buffer size calculations.
